subject: Accounting for spatial autocorrelation & a class

messages.author: 6b0398f60fd2d0a1
messages.subject: Accounting for spatial autocorrelation & a class
parts:
I know there was a thread a few days back about spatial SEM. I had a related question. One method for dealing with spatial autocorrelation (aside from fitting with gls models with the right autocorrelation structure) is adjusting SEs and DF using Moran’s I based on spatial autocorrelation of residuals. Does anyone have a good example of that in lavaan using the residuals function?

I’m searching about for a good teaching example (and if you’re interested, perhaps a guest post on my blog about it?) as this comes up again and a again and I don’t have one in my back pocket.

On a related note, for anyone who knows any ecologists or evolutionary biologists interested in learning a bit about SEM using lavaan this January 5-9, I’ll be teaching a short workshop at UMass Boston.  Registration for it is at http://caps-courses.umb.edu/courses/winter/cr/gr/biol/

-Jarrett
